subject: [PATCH v5 07/19] selftests/mm: move is_backed_by_folio() into vm_util

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch moves the function `is_backed_by_folio()` from `split_huge_page_test.c` to `vm_util.c`. The function checks if an address range is backed by a folio of a given order, which is useful for tests that build or collapse large folios. The move allows other tests to use this functionality without duplicating code. No functional changes are made.
